items.quote: because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
items.contrast: The stated cause—the Danites had not received an inheritance—versus the background fact that Israel had no king.
items.reason: Israel’s lack of a king could be mistaken for the cause, but the explicit “because” clause uniquely identifies why the Danites were seeking a place to settle. The key accurately paraphrases that cause.
